Hassle back potatoes with creamy Cajun chicken and airfried brocollini . Easy, healthy comfort meal  Potato recipe 6 medium potatoes 3 tbsp butter (melted) 2 tbsp olive oil 4–5 cloves garlic (minced) 1½ tsp paprika 1½ tsp onion granules 1½ tsp garlic granules 1 tsp dried parsley Salt & pepper 1–2 tsp all-purpose seasoning Method: Slice each potato thinly (don’t cut all the way through). Mix melted butter, olive oil, garlic, and all seasonings. Brush generously over all 6 potatoes, getting into the layers. Air fry at 180°C for 35–45 mins (depending on size). Brush with extra butter halfway through for that crispy finish. Chicken recipe  Ingredients: 1 tbsp olive oil 1½ tsp Cajun seasoning ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper 1 tsp paprika 1 tsp onion powder Method: Add the sliced chicken to a bowl. Drizzle over the olive oil. Sprinkle all the seasonings evenly. Mix well until every piece is fully coated. Let it sit for 10–15 minutes (optional, but boosts flavor). Pan-fry on medium-high heat until golden and cooked through. Cajun Sauce: 1 tbsp butter ½ onion (diced) 150–200ml heavy cream Same seasonings as chicken Instructions  In the same pan, melt butter and cook onions until soft. Add cream + seasoning, simmer until thickened. Add chicken back in and coat in sauce. #dinnerideas #recipe #easyrecipes #cooking #airfryerrecipe

cheesy chicken fajita pasta bake review: Solid 9 out of 10! Would smash again. Easy, filling, high protein and actually tastes like real food. Win. Ingredients Makes 4 servings 200g dry pasta of choice 650g chicken breast 80g grated mozzarella 1 onion 2 peppers 200g low-fat cream cheese 4 tsp lazy garlic 1 fajita seasoning packet 1 tin 400g chopped tomatoes Salt Pepper 100ml water Cooking steps 	1.	Preheat the oven to 190°C. 	2.	Dice the chicken, onion and peppers. 	3.	Add everything into a large ovenproof dish except the mozzarella. That’s pasta, chicken, veg, cream cheese, garlic, fajita seasoning, chopped tomatoes, salt and pepper. 	4.	Rinse out the chopped tomato tin with 100ml water and pour it into the dish. Mix everything really well so it’s evenly coated. 	5.	Sprinkle the mozzarella evenly over the top. 	6.	Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes at 190°C. Remove the foil and bake for another 5 minutes to melt and colour the cheese. 	7.	Remove from the oven and let it rest for 5 to 10 minutes so the sauce thickens and the pasta soaks everything up. 	8.	Serve and enjoy. Calories & macros per serving 551 calories 57g protein 55g carbs 13g fat Very fat-loss friendly for how filling it is. Credit @Dave Fell

Had to turn my viral baked lasagne jacket into a tray bake for four … because one potato simply isn’t enough when comfort food calls 🥔😂 This is a take on my baked lasagne style jacket potato just bigger, better, and perfect for feeding four instead of one. Fluffy crispy jackets. Rich leftover Bolognese. Creamy cheesy béchamel. Finished with a golden cheese melt. Would you share this… or keep the whole tray to yourself? 👀 🥔 Lasagne-Style Jacket Potato Tray Bake Serves 4 Ingredients Jackets • 4 large baking potatoes • Olive oil spray • Sea salt & black pepper • 40g butter Filling • 600–700g leftover Bolognese sauce Cheesy Béchamel Sauce • 40g butter • 40g plain flour • 500ml semi-skimmed milk • Black pepper • 100g mixed grated cheese • 30–40g grated Parmesan For layering • 150–200g mozzarella or mixed cheese • Extra Parmesan for topping Method 1. Cook the jacket potatoes Pierce potatoes, rub with olive oil and salt. Air fry at 180°C for 45 minutes, then another 10 minutes until crispy. Oven option: 200°C for about 1 hour until fluffy inside and crunchy outside. 2. Make the cheesy béchamel Melt butter in a pan over medium heat. Stir in flour and cook for 1 minute. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth and thickened. Season with black pepper, then stir through mixed cheese and Parmesan until melted and creamy. Set aside. 3. Assemble the tray bake Place all 4 crispy jackets into a large tray. Slice open and gently mash the centres with butter, salt and pepper. 👉 Spoon 1 tablespoon of béchamel into each potato and mix through the fluffy middle. Now layer in this order: • Add the leftover Bolognese • Pour over more béchamel sauce • Sprinkle over mozzarella or mixed cheese • Finish with a generous grating of Parmesan 4. Final melt Bake at 180°C for 10–12 minutes or air fry at 180°C for 4–5 minutes until golden, bubbling and irresistible. #foryoupagе #spud #jacketpotato #jacketpotatoes #lasagna

This is seriously one of the best appetizers I’ve ever made, and easy to throw together! 🤤 roasted tomato burrata dip with garlic bread crostinis!) 🍅🧄 Ripe bursted cherry tomatoes, stir in burrata, and scoop it all up with crispy garlic crostinis. A total flavor bomb… have the recipe ready, people WILL ask for it! 🛒You’ll Need: • cherry tomatoes • Olive oil • Salt, pepper, red pepper flakes • Garlic, parsley, oregano • Burrata • Fresh basil • Parmesan • French baguette • Butter, garlic, salt, parm (for garlic butter) 🧈 How to Make: 	1.	Add grape tomatoes to a baking dish and drizzle generously with olive oil (about halfway up). 	2.	Season with salt, pepper, red pepper flakes, garlic, parsley, and oregano. 	3.	Bake at 425°F for 20-30 mins until tomatoes burst (you can gently smash them halfway if they need some assistance in the ‘bursting’ process). 	4.	While that bakes, slice baguette, spread with garlic butter (butter, garlic, salt, parm), and toast 5–7 mins until golden. 	5.	Once you’re ready to serve, top with parm, fresh basil, and burrata. Stir it all together and serve HOT. Dip. Scoop. Repeat. Tarte 3 Chocolats Sans Cuisson Ingrédients Base biscuitée • 150 g de biscuits au cacao  • 60 g de beurre fondu Ganache au chocolat blanc • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 240 g de chocolat blanc Ganache au chocolat au lait • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 188 g de chocolat au lait Ganache au chocolat noir • 125 g de crème liquide entière • 105 g de chocolat noir Préparation Préparez la base biscuitée Réduisez les biscuits en poudre fine. Ajoutez le beurre fondu et mélangez jusqu'à obtenir une texture de sable humide. Versez le mélange dans un moule à tarte ou un cercle de 20 cm de diamètre. Tassez fermement le fond ainsi que les bords à l'aide du dos d'une cuillère ou d'un verre. Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 30 minutes. Préparez la ganache au chocolat blanc Hachez finement le chocolat blanc et placez-le dans un saladier. Faites chauffer la crème jusqu'à frémissement, puis versez-la sur le chocolat.  mélangez délicatement du centre vers l'extérieur jusqu'à obtenir une ganache parfaitement lisse. Versez la ganache sur la base biscuitée froide. Placez au réfrigérateur pendant 45 minutes à 1 heure, jusqu'à ce que la surface soit suffisamment ferme pour accueillir la couche suivante. Préparez la ganache au chocolat au lait Hachez le chocolat au lait et déposez-le dans un saladier. Portez la crème à frémissement puis versez-la sur le chocolat. Laissez reposer 1 minute puis mélangez jusqu'à obtenir une texture lisse et brillante. Versez délicatement cette ganache sur la couche de chocolat blanc bien prise.  Placez à nouveau au réfrigérateur pendant 45 minutes à 1 heure. Préparez la ganache au chocolat noir Hachez le chocolat noir et placez-le dans un saladier. Faites chauffer la crème jusqu'à frémissement puis versez-la sur le chocolat.  Versez délicatement sur la couche de chocolat au lait. 🇬🇧 No-Bake Triple Chocolate Tart Ingredients Biscuit Base • 150 g cocoa biscuits • 60 g melted butter White Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 240 g white chocolate Milk Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 188 g milk chocolate Dark Chocolate Ganache • 125 g heavy cream • 105 g dark chocolate Preparation Prepare the Biscuit Base Crush the biscuits into a fine powder. Add the melted butter and mix until you get a texture similar to wet sand. Pour the mixture into a tart pan or a 20 cm pastry ring. Firmly press it onto the base and up the sides using the back of a spoon or a glass. Place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes. Prepare the White Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the white chocolate and place it in a bowl. Heat the cream until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Mix gently from the center outward until the ganache is perfectly smooth. Pour the ganache over the chilled biscuit base. Place in the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour, until the surface is firm enough to support the next layer. Prepare the Milk Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the milk chocolate and place it in a bowl. Bring the cream to a simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Let it sit for 1 minute, then stir until smooth and glossy. Carefully pour this ganache over the set white chocolate layer. Return to the refrigerator for 45 minutes to 1 hour. Prepare the Dark Chocolate Ganache Finely chop the dark chocolate and place it in a bowl. Heat the cream until it begins to simmer, then pour it over the chocolate. Carefully pour the ganache over the milk chocolate layer.

videos.caption: crispy chicken caesar salad wrap 🌯🍽️  and thank you SO much for 500k 🫶🏽🥹   recipe:    4 chicken breasts  1 cup all-purpose flour (120g)   seasonings (to taste): salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, italian seasoning, chili powder, kinder bold chicken seasoning blend ( i used this to season the chicken and flour )    for the wet mixture : 2 eggs 2–3 tbsp heavy cream (30–45g) 1–2 tbsp pickle juice     panko: 1½ cups panko breadcrumbs (90g) 2–3 tbsp grated parmesan (optional)    other ingredients: romaine lettuce tortillas  extra parmesan oil for frying   season the chicken generously with your spices. in one bowl, mix the flour with any remaining seasoning. in another bowl, whisk the eggs, cream, and pickle juice. in a third bowl, combine the panko and parmesan. coat each piece of chicken in the flour, then the egg mixture, then press into the panko until fully coated. let the breaded chicken rest for 5–10 minutes so the coating sticks. fry in oil over medium heat until golden and cooked through, about 4–5 minutes per side. remove and let drain    caesar dressing 1 cup mayo (240g) ½ cup finely grated parmesan (50g) 2–3 cloves garlic, minced 2 tbsp lemon juice (30g) 1 tbsp dijon mustard (15g) 1 tsp worcestershire ½ tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper ¼ cup olive oil (60g) 2–4 tbsp water (to thin if needed)   for the dressing, whisk together the mayo, parmesan, garlic, lemon juice, dijon, worcestershire, salt, and pepper. slowly whisk in the olive oil, then add water as needed until smooth and pourable. toss chopped romaine with some of the dressing. assemble the wraps with dressing, lettuce, crispy chicken, & extra parmesan. wrap tightly, and enjoy.    #caesarsalad #crispychicken #wraps #EasyRecipe #Recipe

This One Pan Chicken & Gravy is an easy and delicious 30 minute dinner!  INGREDIENTS  1 lb chicken breasts  Salt, pepper, garlic powder  3 tbsp butter 3 tbsp flour  2 cups chicken broth  1/2 tsp each of salt, pepper, oregano, and thyme  1 tsp each of paprika, onion powder, garlic powder  INSTRUCTIONS  Cut chicken breasts in half lengthwise to make them thinner. Season the chicken with some salt, pepper, and garlic powder (I don’t use exact measurements for this part).  In a skillet over medium high heat melt 3 tbsp of butter. Once the butter has melted add 3 tbsp of flour and stir continuously until well combined. Let cook for a few minutes while still stirring.  Add 2 cups of chicken broth and stir well. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, thyme, paprika, onion powder, and garlic powder. Stir well and when it starts bubbling add the chicken to the skillet.  Make sure the chicken is covered in the gravy, cover with a lid, and turn the heat down to medium low. Let this cook for 12-15 minutes or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of 165 degrees. My chicken was ready in 12 minutes, but they were pretty thin.  Shred the chicken and serve over mashed potatoes! Enjoy! Let me know if you try it out.  #chickenandgravy #easyrecipe #dinner #onepanmeal #chickenrecipes

Whisk buttermilk, lemon juice, soy sauce, hot sauce, and seasonings in a bowl. Add chicken and marinate at least 30 minutes. 2. In a shallow dish, whisk flour, cornstarch, baking powder, and dry coating seasonings together. 3. Dredge chicken in flour mixture, dip back into buttermilk marinade, and coat again in flour. Rest 5 minutes. 4. Fry tenders in 350°F oil for 4 to 6 minutes until golden and 165°F internally. Drain on a wire rack. 5. Simmer glaze ingredients (except butter) in a small pan over medium-low heat until glossy. Remove from heat and whisk in cold butter. Brush over tenders. 6. Whisk all ranch ingredients in a bowl until smooth. Serve chilled with hot tenders. #recipe #cooking #asmr

Sheet Pan Parmesan Garlic Chicken Thighs are an easy and delicious dinner!  INGREDIENTS  2 lb boneless chicken thighs  Buffalo Wild Wings Parmesan Garlic sauce  1 tsp each salt, pepper, Italian seasoning, and onion powder  2 tsp each garlic powder and smoked paprika  Small head of broccoli, chopped  24 oz baby potatoes  1 onion, sliced  Olive oil   Parmesan cheese  INSTRUCTIONS  Preheat the oven to 400 degrees F. Spray a large sheet pan with cooking spray.  Wash the baby potatoes and quarter them. Slice an onion and chop your broccoli. Be sure to leave the broccoli in slightly larger pieces. Add all of the veggies to the sheet pan and drizzle some olive oil over them. Season the veggies with about half of the seasoning blend.  Next, add the chicken thighs to a bowl and season with the rest of the seasoning. Add enough Parmesan Garlic sauce to coat the chicken. Stir until the chicken is well coated in seasoning and sauce.  Bake at 400 degrees F for about 35 minutes, or until the chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 185 degrees F. Broil for just a few minutes if desired. Top everything with some shredded Parmesan cheese. Enjoy!  #sheetpanmeal #dinner #parmesangarlic #chickenthighs #easyrecipes

Creamy Tuscan Chicken 🍗✨ This creamy Tuscan chicken is packed with juicy seasoned chicken, garlic, spinach, and sweet grape tomatoes in a rich Parmesan cream sauce. It’s perfect served over pasta, mashed potatoes, or rice! 😋  🍗 Creamy Tuscan Chicken Ingredients:  Chicken seasoning  * 2 to 3 chicken breasts, sliced in half * Salt & pepper * ½ tsp smoked paprika * 1 tsp garlic powder * 1 tbsp Italian seasoning * 1 tsp dried parsley * ½ tsp chili flakes (optional) Sauce: * 1 tbsp butter * ½ onion, diced * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup grape tomatoes, halved * 2 cups spinach * 1 cup heavy cream * ¼ cup grated Parmesan * Salt & pepper, to taste * Fresh parsley Directions: Season the chicken with all the spices. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a skillet and cook the chicken for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and cooked through. Remove and set aside. In the same skillet, melt the butter and sauté the onion and garlic until fragrant. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2–3 minutes, then stir in the spinach until wilted. Pour in the heavy cream and Parmesan, stirring until smooth and creamy. Season with salt and pepper to taste. Return the chicken to the skillet and let simmer for 2–3 minutes. High Protein Grilled Chicken Alfredo Pasta! Only 595 Calories🍗🍝🧀 One of the most indulgent meal preps i’ve made! Chicken is cooked to perfection, paired with a rich creamy Alfredo Pasta. So simple and easy with great macros🤌🏽 Macros Per Serving (4 Servings Total) 595 Calories | 59g Protein | 50g Carbs | 16g Fat Ingredients (To Make 4 Servings) Grilled Chicken - 800g Cubed Chicken Breast (I get mine from @saffron_alley ) - 1 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1.5 Tsp Parsley - 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (remove if you don’t like spicy) - 1.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 1.5 Tsp Paprika - 2 Tsp Olive Oil - 20g Light Buttet (For cooking + once cooked) Creamy Alfredo Pasta - 210g Uncooked / 520g Cooked Pasta (I chose fettuccine) - 80g Chopped White Onion - 4 Garlic Cloves Chopped - 1 Tsp Salt - 1 Tsp Italian Herbs - 1 Tsp Parsley - 0.5 Tsp Chilli Flakes (remove if you don’t like spicy) - 1 Tsp Paprika - 150g Tomato Sauce / Passata  - 300ml Light Evaporated Milk (Brand: Sainsbury’s) - 130g Light Cream Cheese (Brand: Philadelphia) - 30g Grated Parmesan Cheese - Optional add Pasta Water if the sauce is too thick Don’t forget to check out my Digital Cookbooks with over 200+ Delicious High Protein Recipes👨‍🍳❤️ Important Cooking Notes - Cook the chicken cubes on medium high heat, 3-4 mins then turn them over and cook for another 3 mins - Once cooked, lower the heat, add a little more butter then mix it all in and set aside - Cook the onion for 5-6mins till soft then add the spices. Mix it in for a min before adding the tomato sauce - You want to let this sauce cook for at least 5mins on low heat till it bubbles and separates a little - Add the milk and cream cheese on low heat, then keep stirring till combined and thick - To reheat, place both chicken and pasta in a pan, low heat, cover with a lid for 5 mins. ⇩ Full Recipe 🍗 ⇩ Macros per 1 meal prep: Protein: 40g Carbs: 87g Fat: 8g Calories: 585 Ingredients per 2 servings (makes 2 meal preps): Chicken - 1lb chicken thigh, boneless, skinless, raw - 2 tsp salt - 2 tsp black pepper - 1/4 cup cornstarch - 1/3 second spray oil - 1 tsp sesame seeds -1 green onion Soy Glaze Sauce - 2.5 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tbsp oyster sauce - 2.5 tbsp honey - 1.5 tbsp minced garlic Cucumber Salad - 2 Persian cucumbers - 2 tsp salt - 1.5 tbsp rice vinegar - 2 tsp brown sugar - 1/2 tbsp soy sauce - 1 tsp sesame seeds 1.5 cup cooked rice How to make it yourself: 1. Dice your cucumbers into thin circles. 2. Lay your chicken thighs flat, season with salt and pepper, and coat evenly with cornstarch on both sides 3. In a bowl, mixed together, soy sauce, oyster sauce, honey, and minced garlic to make your sauce. 4. On a pan coated with spray oil on medium heat, cook your chicken until golden brown, crispy on both sides, and cooked through. 5. Remove the cooked chicken from the pan and pour in your sauce to let it simmer for 45 seconds the add back in your chicken and let it coat the sauce for a minute then quickly remove. 6. In a bowl, mix together your sliced cucumbers with salt. Let it sit for 15 minutes until the excess liquid drains from the cucumbers. 7. Remove the excess liquid from the cucumbers and rinse the cucumbers with water. 8. Pat dry the cucumbers and add them into a bowl with rice vinegar, brown sugar, soy sauce, and sesame seeds and mix well to make your salad. 9. In a meal prep container, add 1/2 your steamed rice, 1/2 your cucumber salad, and 1/2 your chicken optionally topped with sesame seeds and sliced green onions. 10. Pro tip: when meal prepping to re-heat, make sure to put your salad & meat into separate ziploc bags to avoid getting the rice soggy. When ready to eat, microwave the rice with a wet paper towel first to get it steamed, then add in your meat and microwave till warm, and finally add your salad to preserve the crunch and enjoy! 📩 Save this Soy Glazed Chicken recipe to make for later! #highprotein #lowcaloriemeals #mealprep #mealplan #healthyrecipe #weightlossmeals #asianfood #chicken

Creamy Pesto Chicken Pasta Bake ✨ My most viral recipe of 2024!  What a year it’s been. I’m truly so grateful for all the love and support you’ve shown me this year. Cheers to a delicious 2025!  Here’s how to make it: 1lb pasta of choice 1/2 cup sun-dried tomatoes + oil 1lb chicken 1 tbsp butter 1/2 yellow onion, diced Salt and pepper, to taste 1 tsp red pepper flakes (to taste) 1 tsp smoked paprika (to taste) 1 tsp oregano (to taste) 6-8 cloves of garlic, minced (to taste) 2 cups heavy cream (room temp) 1-2 cups cooked broccoli  2 handfuls spinach 6-8 oz freshly shredded parmesan cheese (divided) 8 oz freshly shredded mozzarella (divided) 1/2 cup pesto, to taste (I recommend Costco brand) Parsley to garnish  1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Place the cream on the counter to come to room temp. 2. Boil your noodles in salted water a few minutes less than package instructions (al dente). Drain and set aside.  3. In a large oven-safe saucepan or dutch oven, heat 1 tbsp of sun-dried tomato oil over medium heat. Cook the chicken until it's no longer pink, then remove it from the pan and set it aside. Let it rest for a few minutes before cutting into bite-sized pieces. 4. In the same pan, melt the butter and add salt, pepper, red pepper, paprika, and oregano. Stir to toast, then toss in the onion and sauté for about 4 minutes. Add the garlic and cook for another 30 seconds. 5. Turn heat to low, pour in the heavy cream and stir. Let it simmer for a couple of minutes to thicken slightly. 6. Add half of the parmesan and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese,  stir until the cheese is melted. 7. Stir in the sun-dried tomatoes, cooked broccoli, spinach, chicken, cooked pasta, and pesto. 8. Top with the remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese.  9. Bake at 350°F for 15 minutes, then broil for another 5 minutes, or until the top is golden and bubbly. 10. Sprinkle with fresh parsley, a little more parmesan, and enjoy! #pastabake #chickenpesto #pesto #pestopasta #pestochicken #pasta #pastarecipe #easyrecipe #easyrecipes #easymeal #easydinner #dinnerideas #dinner #foodtok #cooking

Honey Garlic Chicken! 🍯 🧄  Sticky, sweet, garlicky, and comes together so easy… this one’s a weeknight winner every time!! @Courtney Cook made my recipe the other day and it made me want it all over again!! Serve it over rice with a veggie, so good y’all.  Ingredients:  • 3 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs, cut into bite-size pieces  • ½ tbsp garlic salt  • 1 tbsp black pepper  • ¼ cup cornstarch (plus a little extra if you want more crunch)  • 2–3 tbsp vegetable oil (for frying) Sauce:  • ½ cup honey  • ¼ cup soy sauce  • 1 tbsp ginger paste  • 2–3 tbsp minced garlic To Finish:  • Sesame seeds  • Green onions, sliced ⸻ Instructions:  1. Season the chicken In a large bowl, add chicken, garlic salt, black pepper, and cornstarch. Toss until everything is well coated. (Add a little extra cornstarch if you want it extra crispy.)  2. Cook the chicken Heat oil in a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat. Add chicken in batches and cook until browned on both sides with a light crust. Don’t overcrowd the pan. Remove and set aside.  3. Make the sauce Add all the cooked chicken back to the skillet. Pour in honey, soy sauce, ginger paste, and minced garlic. Toss to coat.  4. Simmer Let it simmer for a few minutes until the sauce thickens and gets sticky, coating all the chicken.  5. Finish & serve Top with sesame seeds and green onions. Serve over white rice with your favorite veggie.  #yum #easyrecipe #chicken

Nashville Hot Chicken Mac & Cheese  Recipe ⬇️ Ridiculously creamy four-cheese mac and cheese with a crispy golden cheese crust, topped with crunchy fried chicken coated in a spicy Nashville hot oil! Mac & Cheese 16 oz cavatappi pasta 4 tbsp butter 4 tbsp flour 12 oz evaporated milk 1 cup heavy cream 1 cup whole milk 12 oz Colby Jack 8 oz sharp cheddar 8 oz mozzarella 4 oz Fontina 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp onion powder 1 tsp smoked paprika ½ tsp cayenne pepper 1 tsp Dijon mustard ½ tsp chicken bouillon Salt & black pepper Reserved pasta water Fried Chicken 2 lb chicken tenderloins 2 cups buttermilk 2 tbsp hot sauce 2 cups flour ½ cup cornstarch 1 tbsp paprika 1 tsp each garlic powder, onion powder & cayenne Salt & black pepper Oil for frying Nashville Hot Oil ½ cup hot frying oil 2 tbsp cayenne pepper 1 tbsp brown sugar 2 tsp smoked paprika 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp chili powder ½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp salt Directions Cook pasta 1–2 minutes shy of al dente. Reserve 1 cup pasta water. Melt butter, whisk in flour and cook 1–2 minutes. Slowly add evaporated milk, cream, milk and seasonings. Simmer until slightly thickened. Reduce heat to low and melt in 16 oz of the shredded cheese. Reserve the other 16 oz for layering. Fold in pasta, adding reserved pasta water as needed to keep it extra creamy. Layer half the mac in a baking dish, add 6 oz reserved cheese, then remaining mac and 10 oz cheese on top. Bake uncovered at 350°F for 20–25 minutes, then broil 1–3 minutes until golden and crispy. Marinate chicken in buttermilk and hot sauce for at least 30 minutes. Mix flour, cornstarch and seasonings, then coat chicken thoroughly. Fry chicken at 350°F for 4–6 minutes until crispy and 165°F internally. Combine Nashville hot oil spices in a heatproof bowl. Carefully pour ½ cup hot frying oil over the spices and stir until combined. Brush or toss the fried chicken in Nashville hot oil, then pile it over the baked mac and cheese. Enjoy! 🔥 #nashvillehotchicken #macandcheese #friedchicken #comfortfood #recipe

What’s for dinner tonight? A little taste of sunshine in a pot! 🍋 This Greek lemon chicken and potatoes is an easy weeknight dinner where the oven does all the hard work. Served with a fresh Greek salad, it’s a meal I come back to time and time again. Definitely a family favorite! Prep time: 20 minutes  Bake time: 2 hours  Yields: 7-8 servings  Ingredients: 4 to 5 golden potatoes, peeled and quartered (3 lbs) 7 pieces of chicken (bone-in thighs and drumsticks work beautifully, but use your favorite!) (2 lbs. 10 oz )  You can also use boneless pieces as well, reduce bake time by 30 minutes.  For the sauce: Juice of 2 large lemons about 1/2 cup  1/4 cup good-quality olive oil 1 tbsp Dijon mustard 6 garlic cloves, minced 2 to 3 tsp salt A few sprigs of fresh oregano or 1 tbsp. Dried oregano  1/4 cup water  Dairy free Greek salad:  6 Persian cucumbers  3 beefsteak tomatoes  1 red pepper  1/2 red onion  1 cup pitted Kalamata olives  1 bunch flat head parsley  Dressing:  1/3 cup olive oil  1/4 cup fresh lemon juice  2 tbsp. Red wine vinegar  2 minced garlic cloves  1 tbsp. dried oregano  2 tsp. salt  1 tsp. black pepper  Instructions: Prep the chicken and potatoes:  Peel and rinse your golden potatoes, then cut them into large wedges. Wash and pat dry your chicken pieces. Layer in your pot: Arrange the chicken pieces in a large oven-safe pot or braiser (I use a 14-inch cast iron). Lay the potato wedges on top.  Tip: If your pot has plastic handles, wrap them in foil and you're good to go in the oven. No oven-safe lid? Cover with parchment and foil. Make the sauce: In a jar, combine the olive oil, fresh lemon juice, Dijon mustard, minced garlic, salt, and oregano. Give it a good shake until everything is well mixed and emulsified. Assemble: Pour the sauce evenly over the chicken and potatoes. Add 1/4 cup water to the jar, mix again and pour over.  Bake: Cover and bake in a preheated oven at 375°F (190°C) for 1 hour and 30 minutes. Finish uncovered: After 1.5 hours, remove the lid, baste the chicken and potatoes with those delicious juices, and return to the oven uncovered for 30 minutes, until everything is golden and caramelized. While the chicken is baking, prepare the salad. Combine everything in a bowl.  Prepare the dressing in the sane jar as the sauce for the chicken. Mix well and dress salad.  Toss and enjoy ❤️ Every bite is bursting with flavor — fresh, zesty, and comforting. Let the oven do the work, and enjoy a little taste of Greece right at home. #onepanmeal #sivanskitchen #easyrecipe #greekchicken #chickenandpotatoes

One pot chicken fajita rice skillet smothered in queso 🤤 The easiest weeknight dinner and one of those recipes the whole family will love. Save this one for your next easy dinner! One-Pot Chicken Fajita Rice Skillet Recipe  Ingredients: 1 tablespoon olive oil 1 onion, sliced 3 bell peppers, sliced into strips yellow, red & green 2 chicken breasts, sliced into strips 1 packet fajita seasoning 1 tablespoon garlic 1 can Rotel, undrained 1 cup rice, washed  1 teaspoon tomato bouillon 2 cups chicken broth Queso: 1 can green chiles 1 small can evaporated milk (5 oz) ½ pound white American cheese slices, from the deli Directions: Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. Add the sliced onion and bell peppers and cook until softened. Add the sliced chicken and fajita seasoning. Stir to coat everything and cook until the chicken is fully cooked through. Add the garlic and Rotel. Stir to combine. Add the rice, chicken broth, and tomato bouillon. Stir everything together. Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and cook for 20 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed. While the rice cooks, make the queso. Add the evaporated milk, green chiles, and the white American cheese to a small saucepan over low heat. Stir until the cheese is completely melted and the queso is smooth. Fluff the rice, then pour the queso evenly over the top. Serve hot. #OnePotMeals #DinnerIdeas #EasyRecipe #WeeknightDinner #MealIdeas

Creamy Cajun Chicken Pasta 🔥 One-pot & ready in under 20 minutes… juicy cajun chicken served with the creamiest garlic parmesan sauce 🤤 If there is one piece of cookware you need in your kitchen, it’s gotta be the @Made In Cookware Saucier!  I’ve been using Made In for a long time and the Saucier is my favorite piece to cook with… it can do everything your sauce pan can do, but better!  If you’re looking to upgrade your cookware, I linked my favorite Made In pieces in my bio. For the Chicken:  -2 large chicken breasts, flattened  -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp onion powder, 2 tsp Italian seasoning, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper, 1–2 tsp cayenne pepper (optional)  -1 tbsp olive oil For the Pasta & Sauce:  -8 oz (225 g) rigatoni  -3 tbsp butter  -1 large shallot, finely diced  -6–8 garlic cloves, minced  -1 cup heavy cream, room temperature  -Seasoning: 1 tsp chicken bouillon powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp Italian seasoning, 1 tsp black pepper  -3/4 cup freshly grated Parmesan (please use fresh!)  -1/2 cup pasta water, as needed (aka liquid gold) Instructions: 1. Pat the chicken dry & pound to an even thickness. Coat with 1 tbsp olive oil, then season on both sides. 2. Boil the pasta in salted water until just shy of al dente. Save at least 1/2 cup pasta water before draining (‼️). Set pasta aside. 3. Heat a large pan or pot over medium heat for a few mins. Add 2 tbsp olive oil, increase to medium-high, add the chicken. Sear for 3–4 mins per side until golden, then reduce heat if needed and cook through. Set aside to rest. 4. Reduce heat to medium. In the same pan, melt the butter, scraping up all that fond. Add the shallot & cook for 5 mins, add the garlic, cook for 1 more min. 5. Reduce heat to medium-low, slowly pour in the cream. Add the seasonings & simmer for 2–3 mins. Reduce heat to low, add the parmesan & stir until smooth. 6. Add the pasta & 1/4 cup pasta water, toss over low heat for 1–2 mins until the sauce is silky. Add more pasta water as needed. Slice the chicken, add it on top, and finish with more parm and fresh parsley!  #easydinner #pasta #recipe #cookingathometiktoktv

One-Pan Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls 🔥 All the shawarma flavor, none of the extra steps… juicy spiced chicken, onion rice pilaf, refreshing salad and a creamy garlic sauce 🤌 For the Chicken: -1.5 lbs (680g) boneless, skinless chicken thighs -Seasoning: 1 tbsp paprika, 1 tbsp cumin, 1 tbsp onion powder, 2 tsp coriander, 1 tsp allspice, 2 tsp turmeric, 2 tsp pepper, 1 tsp salt -3 tbsp olive oil + 8 garlic cloves -½ lemon, juiced -2 tsp bouillon (I used the roasted chicken base from @Better Than Bouillon) For the Rice: -3 tbsp butter + 1 ½ cups yellow onion, diced -1 tbsp turmeric, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp pepper -1 ½ cups basmati rice -3 cups hot water  -3 tsp bouillon  For the Fresh Sumac Salad: -½ large red onion, thinly sliced -1 cup cherry tomatoes, quartered -1 cup cucumber, sliced then halved -1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper & 2 tsp sumac -½ lemon, juiced For the Garlic Sauce: -¼ cup mayonnaise + ¼ cup plain Greek yogurt -2 to 3 garlic cloves + 1 tbsp fresh parsley -1 tsp salt + 1 tsp black pepper -½ lemon, juiced + 1 tbsp olive oil 1. In a bowl, combine the chicken with the spices, olive oil, garlic, lemon juice and bouillon. Mix well. Marinate for as long as your patience can handle. 2. Heat a large pan over medium-high heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Once hot, add the chicken in batches. Cook for 6 to 8 mins per side until golden and cooked through. Set aside. 3. Reduce heat to medium-low. Add butter to the same pan then the onions & cook, stirring often, until translucent. Add the garlic & spices, cook for 1 to 2 mins. Add the rice and toast for 2 mins while stirring. Pour in the hot water mixed with bouillon according to package instructions. Stir & bring to a boil. Once boiling, cover & reduce heat to low. Simmer for 20 mins until cooked. 4. Mix the salad ingredients in one bowl and the sauce ingredients in another bowl. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt, paprika, garlic powder, and black pepper. Mix until evenly coated. Heat a large pot over medium heat. Add the chicken and sear for a few minutes on each side until golden. Scatter the sliced onion right over the chicken and let it soften in all the flavor. In a separate bowl or measuring cup, whisk together the broth and tomato paste until smooth. Once the chicken is nicely browned, add the pasta directly into the pot. Pour the tomato broth mixture right over the chicken and pasta and bring everything to a boil. Cover, reduce to a simmer, and cook for about 10 minutes until the pasta is tender and the chicken is fully cooked through. While everything cooks, chop the cucumbers cucumbers, cherry tomatoes, shallot, and avocado. Drizzle with olive oil and fresh lemon and lime juice, season with salt and pepper, and toss. That’s it. Strawberry Pull-Apart Bread 🍓✨ Dough: 3 cups all-purpose flour (360g) 5 tbsp melted butter (71g) 3 tbsp granulated sugar (38g) 1 tsp salt (6g) 2¼ tsp active dry yeast (7g) 1 large egg (50g) ¾ cup warm milk (180g) 1 tsp vanilla extract Simple Glaze: 1 cup powdered sugar (120g) 1–2 tbsp milk (15–30g) 1 tbsp melted butter (14g) Splash of vanilla extract Strawberry Compote Ingredients:  300g strawberries (about 2 cups, chopped) 75–90g granulated sugar (6–7 tbsp) 1 tbsp lemon juice 10–12g cornstarch (1–1½ tbsp) 30g water (2 tbsp) Instructions: In a bowl, mix warm milk, sugar, and yeast and let sit for 8–10 minutes until foamy, then add the egg, melted butter, and vanilla and mix until combined; add in the flour and salt and knead for about 8–10 minutes until smooth, then cover and let rise for 1 hour or until doubled. Meanwhile, make the strawberry compote by cooking strawberries, sugar, and lemon juice over medium heat until soft and juicy (about 5–7 minutes), lightly mash, then stir in the cornstarch mixed with water and cook until thickened, then let cool completely. Roll the dough into a rectangle, spread the strawberry compote evenly over the surface, cut into strips, stack them, and slice into pieces, then place upright into a greased loaf pan, cover and let rise for another 30 minutes before baking at 350°F (175°C) for 35–45 minutes until golden, then mix the glaze ingredients and drizzle over the warm bread. #breadmaking #strawberry #pullapartbread #baking #recipes

For the Chicken: -2 lbs (0.9 kg) chicken breast, sliced into strips -2 cups buttermilk -1/3 cup pickle juice -Seasonings: 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp paprika, 1 tsp cayenne pepper, 1 tsp onion powder, 1 tsp salt, 1 tsp black pepper -Neutral oil, for frying Flour Mixture: -2 cups all-purpose flour +1/2 cup cornstarch -1 tsp baking powder -Seasonings: 2 tsp garlic powder, 2 tsp paprika, 2 tsp salt, 2 tsp black pepper Hot Honey Sauce: -1/4 cup butter -2 to 3 tbsps hot sauce -1/3 cup honey For the Ranch:  -1/2 cup mayonnaise + 1/2 cup sour cream -1/2 cup cold buttermilk (use less for a thicker dip) -1 teaspoon red wine vinegar  -1 teaspoon dried parsley -1 tbsp fresh dill weed (or 1 tsp dried dill) -Spices: 1/2 tsp garlic powder, 1/2 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper -1 tbsp fresh chives, optional Instructions: 1. The Arctic Fox (Vulpes lagopus), sometimes called the snow fox, is a small but remarkably hardy fox adapted to some of the coldest environments on Earth. Its thick fur changes with the seasons white during winter to blend into snow and brown or grey in summer to camouflage against rocks and vegetation. Its compact body, short ears, and furry paws help conserve heat in freezing conditions. Arctic foxes are symbols of adaptability, resilience, intelligence, and survival. They inhabit Arctic tundra across the Northern Hemisphere and can withstand temperatures far below freezing while searching for rodents, birds, eggs, fish, and carrion. Fun fact: An Arctic fox can survive temperatures approaching −50°C (−58°F), partly because its thick winter coat provides exceptional insulation. #ArcticFox #SnowFox #VulpesLagopus #Wildlife #Winter

Cheesy Italian Chicken Crunchwrap 🍗🌯 Prep time: 10 mins | Cook time: 5 mins | Servings: 4 Ingredients:  3 cups roughly shredded rotisserie chicken or cooked chicken breast  1 1/2 tsp salt-free Italian seasoning  1/2 tsp kosher salt  1/8 tsp black pepper  1 cup marinara sauce (plus extra warmed sauce for serving, optional)  1/4 cup finely chopped fresh basil  4 large soft flour tortillas, 4 small flour tortillas 1 cup shredded reduced-fat Italian cheese blend Instructions: 1. In a large, shallow pot, combine the water, gochujang, soy sauce, sugar, garlic powder, kimchi, and and curry powder (if using). Stir until the gochujang dissolves. Bring to a boil, then cook for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally. 2. Arrange your add-ins in the pot, leaving out the ramen and cheese. Bring the broth back to a boil, cover, and cook for 10 minutes. 3. Add the ramen and cook for 5–7 minutes, stirring frequently to keep the noodles from sticking and help them cook evenly. Bacon Wrapped Carrots with a Maple Dijon Glaze 🥕🥓 the side dish you need to add to your Thanksgiving menu this year! The key step is to roast them on a wire rack so the bacon gets super crispy all around and anything that burns drips onto the aluminum foil for easy cleanup. These are absolutely delicious!  Search ‘crowded kitchen bacon wrapped carrots’ online for the full recipe or head straight here: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/bacon-wrapped-carrots/ 10 medium carrots about 8 inches long, peeled 10 slices regular-cut bacon Glaze:  3 tablespoons pure maple syrup 2 tablespoons honey 1 tablespoon Dijon mustard 1 tablespoon olive oil ½ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon smoked paprika ¼ teaspoon dried thyme ¼ teaspoon black pepper 1 teaspoon apple cider vinegar Preheat the oven to 400˚F/200˚C. Set a wire rack over an aluminum foil-lined sheet pan. To a large pot of boiling water, add the whole carrots and blanch for 6 to 7 minutes (about 4 for thin carrots, 8 to 9 for extra-thick ones). Drain and pat completely dry. Starting at the thick end of the carrot, wrap one slice of bacon around each carrot in a spiral. Space the turns so a stripe of carrot shows between each one, with no overlap. At each end, push a toothpick all the way through the bacon and the carrot so it comes out through the bacon on the other side. Lay the carrots on the rack. Place the carrots in the oven for 10, until the fat in the bacon starts to render. Meanwhile, whisk together the maple syrup, honey, Dijon, olive oil, kosher salt, smoked paprika, thyme, black pepper and apple cider vinegar until well combined. Brush the top side of the carrots with about ⅓ of the glaze, then return to the oven and cook another 10-12 minutes. Flip the carrots, brush the side now facing up with another ⅓ of the glaze, and return to the oven for another 10-12 minutes. Flip again, brush with the remaining glaze, and cook a final 10-12 minutes, until the bacon is crisp and the glaze is glossy and set. Test for doneness by sliding a paring knife into the thickest part of a carrot. If it goes in easily, they're done. If not, return them to the oven for 5 more minutes, laying a sheet of foil loosely over the top if the bacon is already crisp. Let rest for 5 minutes so the glaze can set, then remove the toothpicks and finish with herbs. Don't leave the carrots on the wire rack for more than 5 to 10 minutes, or the glaze can make them hard to remove.

videos.caption: Sticky Chicken Tender, seasoned chicken coated in a sweet and savory sticky sauce, served over warm rice and finished with green onions and sesame seeds. Ingredients For the Chicken 1.5 lbs chicken breast, cut into bite-sized pieces 1 teaspoon each onion powder, garlic powder, and teaspoon salt ½ teaspoon each black pepper and paprika  2 tablespoons olive oil About ⅓ cup cornstarch Olive oil, for cooking For the Sticky Sauce ½ cup soy sauce ⅓ cup brown sugar or honey 1 tablespoon hoisin sauce 1 tablespoon ketchup 1 teaspoon ginger paste ½ tablespoon minced garlic 1 tablespoon cornstarch 2 tablespoons butter For Serving Cooked white rice Sliced green onions Sesame seeds Instructions 1. Add the chicken to a large bowl and season with onion powder, garlic powder, salt, black pepper, and paprika. Add 2 tablespoons of olive oil and toss until the chicken is evenly coated. 2. Sprinkle about ⅓ cup cornstarch over the seasoned chicken and toss until each piece is lightly and evenly coated. This helps give the chicken that tender, velvety texture and creates a great coating for the sauce. 3. In a bowl, whisk together the soy sauce, brown sugar or honey, hoisin sauce, ketchup, ginger paste, minced garlic, and 1½ tablespoons cornstarch until smooth. Set aside. 4. Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Cook the chicken in 2 batches so you don't overcrowd the pan. Cook until golden brown on the outside and cooked through. Remove the chicken from the skillet and set aside. 5. Reduce the heat and add 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet, scraping up all those flavorful browned bits from the bottom of the pan. 6. Pour the prepared sauce into the skillet. Cook over low heat, whisking frequently, until the sauce begins to bubble and thickens into a glossy, sticky consistency. 7. Add the cooked chicken back to the skillet and toss until every piece is completely coated in the sticky sauce. 8. Spoon the sticky chicken over warm rice and finish with sliced green onion.  #easyrecipe #dinnerideas #quickrecipes #easydinner #dinnerrecipes

Here are three easy rotisserie chicken meals that are in my dinner rotation.  Just pick up a rotisserie chicken, or two, or three and make a meal prep out of it. I tried a new red enchilada sauce and it was seriously delicious. I was skeptical about the peanut butter, but then I was pleasantly surprised with how delicious it tasted. My entire family loved it!  Here are the recipes and instructions.  *Chicken Alfredo  3 tablespoons salted butter 3 garlic cloves, minced 1 teaspoon onion powder 4 cups heavy cream 1 cup shredded Parmesan cheese 1/2 teaspoon fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 teaspoon ground black pepper, plus more to taste 1 tbsp parsley leaves 16 oz penne pasta  3-4 cups shredded chicken  1 broccoli head, cut into bite sized pieces    1. Cook pasta according to the package instructions until al dente, stirring occasionally.  2. While the pasta cooks, in a small saucepan over medium heat, melt the butter. Add the garlic and onion powder and whisk for 30 seconds, just until fragrant. Whisk in the cream and bring the mixture to a simmer. Reduce the heat to low and add the Parmesan. Whisk until the cheese is melted into the sauce, 1 to 2 minutes. Be careful not to let the sauce boil. Turn off the heat then season with salt and pepper. Add more if needed.  3. Add chicken, broccoli and pasta and toss until everything is coated.  Optional: add red pepper flakes for a little kick  *Chicken Noodle Soup  3 cups shredded chicken  3 Tbsp avocado oil  2 medium carrots,  sliced into thin circles 4 large sticks of celery, finely diced 1 small/medium onion, finely diced 8 cups chicken stock  4 cups water 4 medium potatoes,  peeled and cubed  2 bay leaves 2 Tbsp parsley 1 1/2 tsp fine sea salt, plus more to taste 1/2 tsp black pepper 1 1/2 cups egg noodle pasta, or use 3/4 cup small pasta  1 garlic glove, minced  Directions: 1. In a large soup pot over medium- high heat, add 2 Tbsp olive oil. Once oil is hot, add onions, carrots, and celery and sauté until softened and golden, stirring frequently for 5-7 minutes.  2. Add broth, water, potatoes, bay leaf, 1 1/2 tsp salt and 1/2 tsp black pepper. Bring to a boil and continue cooking at a medium boil for 10 minutes 3. Add pasta and chicken and cook for 5 minutes or until pasta and potatoes are tender. Add more salt and pepper to taste. 4. Press in 1 garlic clove and stir in parsley then remove from heat and enjoy.  *Green Sauce Enchiladas  15-20 corn tortillas (you can make as many or little as you want)  28 ounce can of Las Palmas Green Chile Enchilada Sauce  Avocado oil (enough to cover the bottom of a pan)  1/4 of an onion, diced  2 tsp dried oregano  1 to 2 cups shredded chicken  3/4 tbsps white vinegar  Directions: 1. Add oil to a pan and heat on medium/low heat.  2. Take a stack of 5-10 tortillas, wrap in a paper towel and microwave for a minute. Just enough to soften so they don't break when handled.  3. Once oil is hot, add the tortillas one by one and allow them to lightly fry (2 to 3 seconds) then remove from oil and place them on paper towels to drain.  4. Heat sauce in a medium sized sauce pan on low and bring to a simmer. Remove and set aside. 5. Chop 1/4 cup onion and add about 3/4 tbsp of white vinegar and dried oregano. Mix to combine and set aside.  Assemble: To eat right away- -dip oiled tortillas into sauce. Add shredded chicken and about 1 tsp of the onion, oregano, vinegar mixture then roll up tightly and place in pan with the seam side down. Repeat process with the remaining tortillas.  When you plate them, top with shredded lettuce, queso fresco, and a few slices of avocado. You can also add sour cream and hot sauce. 😉 To freeze them and serve later- *prepare everything the same way but DO NOT add the sauce. Heat and add the sauce when you are ready to eat them.  *Red Sauce Enchiladas  Recipe in comments. An Easy Date Night One Pan Meal From Me to You 🍲 Cooking is a skill like anything else. The more effort and focus you give to it the easier it will be and the better you will get. If you are a beginner here’s an easy place to start.  — Ingredients: - 1lb boneless skinless chicken thighs - 2 cups of white rice - 2 cups of chicken stock  - avocado oil  - tbsp chilli crunch oil  - 1 half of a medium sized yellow onion (diced) - 4-6 cloves of minced garlic  - parsley (chopped) - juice of 1/2 a lemon - parmesan cheese - seasoning blend (salt, pepper, onion powder, mushroom powder, smoked paprika, cayenne pepper (small amount)) METHOD: - chop up everything and WASH YOUR RICE - season your chicken  - pan medium-high heat  - add avocado oil  - add chicken thighs “skin” side down - get a good sear and flip (we aren’t trying to cook them all the way right now) - turn heat down to half way between medium and low - cook chicken 1-2 more minutes and remove - add in chili crisp oil, onion and garlic  - sautee 1-2 minutes and then turn heat back up  - add your washed rice and toss together till water has evaporated (rice looks dry) - add a couple pinches of salt  - once incorporated add 2cups of chicken broth  - bring to a boil and add back in your chicken thighs - turn heat to low and cover for 12 minutes - finish with a squeeze of lemon, chopped paraely, and parmesean cheese on top  ENJOY! 🤝

This chicken recipe went viral for a reason… 🤤🍗 Almost 800K views later, and we’re STILL making it every Sunday! 😂 At this point, my family just knows what’s for dinner, and honestly, nobody’s complaining! It’s easy, packed with flavor, and turns out AMAZING every single time. Served over mashed potatoes with that delicious gravy?! SO GOOD! 🤌🏼 🍗 VIRAL CHICKEN THIGHS Ingredients: • Boneless chicken thighs • Salt & pepper • Garlic powder • Paprika • Italian seasoning • Olive oil • 1 onion, sliced • 2 cups chicken broth • Fresh thyme • Cornstarch + cold water (for gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. 2. Place chicken thighs in a baking dish. Season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and Italian seasoning. 3. Drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat evenly. 4. Add sliced onion, pour 2 cups of chicken broth over everything, and add fresh thyme. 5. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for 90 minutes. 6. Remove from oven, take out the thyme, and carefully drain the cooking liquid into a separate bowl. 7. Mix cornstarch with cold water to make a slurry, then stir it into the cooking liquid. 8. Pour the gravy mixture back over the chicken. 9. Return to the oven UNCOVERED at 450°F for another 30 minutes! We love serving ours over mashed potatoes with roasted green beans and honey butter rolls! 🤎 SAVE this for your next Sunday dinner! I promise it’s one you’ll make again and again! Garlic Parmesean Wraps✨🧄🌯 #homemadefood #EasyRecipes #cookingathome #dinnerideas #homecooking Recipe:  For the Chicken • 3 chicken breasts, butterflied • Olive oil • Paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt, pepper, thyme, cayenne, red pepper flakes, ginger garlic paste  Fries: • 2 large russet potatoes, cut into fries • Avocado oil, paprika, onion powder, garlic powder, salt & pepper Garlic Parmesan Sauce: • 2 tbsp butter • ½ diced onion • 4 minced garlic cloves • 1 cup heavy cream • Garlic powder, onion powder, cayenne & fresh parsley • ½–1 cup Parmesan cheese Wraps: • Large tortillas • Parmesan & optional mozzarella Instructions: 1. Season chicken with olive oil and all seasonings. Sear in avocado or olive oil until golden and cooked to 165°F. Set aside. 2. Soak fries in cold water for 20 minutes. Drain, dry, season, and bake at 425°F for about 40 minutes, flipping halfway. 3. In the same pan, melt butter. Sauté onion, then garlic for 30 seconds. Add heavy cream, seasonings, and parsley. Stir in Parmesan and simmer on low until thick. 4. Add sauce, fries, chicken, and cheese to a tortilla. Fold tightly and toast in an oiled pan until golden on both sides. 5. Serve with extra garlic Parmesan sauce for dipping and a side kale salad. 🤍

dinner with a dietitian: street corn inspired chicken rice bowls..you don’t even have to turn on the oven. 👌🏻 Flavor + Nutrition are my top 2 priorities when it comes to dinner. What I love about these: Balanced meal with lots of nutrition. Great for meal prep. Easy to customize. Full recipe below ⬇️ or grab it here: https://mallorythedietitian.com/street-corn-chicken-rice-bowl/ INGREDIENTS For Chicken • 1½ lb chicken breasts (or thighs) • 3 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil (1 for marinating + 2 for cooking) • 1½ tsp chili powder • 1 tsp each: smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp onion powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Dressing • 1 c Greek yogurt • 2 Tbsp mayo • 1 lime, zest & juice • ½ tsp each: chili powder, smoked paprika, garlic powder • ½ tsp kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper • 1-3 Tbsp water (as needed to thin it out) For Street Corn • 3 c corn, cooked • ½ red bell pepper, chopped • 1 small jalapeno, chopped • ¼ c red onion, chopped • ¼ c cilantro, chopped • ¼ c cotija cheese For Cilantro Lime Rice • 1 c jasmine rice, uncooked • 1 Tbsp extra virgin olive oil • ½ c cilantro, chopped • 2 Tbsp lime juice • ½ tsp each: garlic powder, kosher salt • ¼ tsp black pepper For Assembling (opt) • romaine  • avo • tomatoes DIRECTIONS 1. Prep chicken: Cut chicken into cubes. Coat in 1 Tbsp olive oil + seasonings. Set aside to let marinade. 2. Make rice: cook rice according to package. Mix in cilantro, lime, olive oil, gp, s&p. 3. Prep Dressing: make the Elote dressing by mixing the ingredients listed. 4. Make Street Corn: remove corn from cob & chop the jalapeno, red pepper, onion, & cilantro. Add everything to a  bowl. Top w/cotija cheese & half the dressing. 5. Cook chicken: heat a skillet on medium-high. Add olive oil until hot. Add chicken & cook 3-4 min on one side. Flip & cook another 3-4 min until cooked to internal temp 165℉ (75°C) 6. Assemble: Add romaine (opt), rice, chicken & corn to a bowl. Top with more dressing, lime, & fave toppings!  NUTRITION (per bowl, makes 6)* 470 cal, 34g pro, 43g carb, 19g fat *nutrition info based on serving size rec: ½ c chicken, ½ c rice, ¾ c corn salad, 2 Tbsp dressing, ½ c romaine (opt) Follow for healthy recipes! Dinners That Pay My Rent, Episode 1: Creamy Garlic Butter Chicken Pasta 🍗🍝 Crispy skin-on chicken over penne in a creamy garlic parmesan sauce, all in one pan. Ready in about 30 minutes. Ingredients: - 2 bone-in, skin-on chicken thighs - Salt & black pepper, to taste - 1 tsp garlic powder - 1 tsp paprika - 4-5 oz penne pasta (about 2 cups dry) For the sauce: - 1 tbsp unsalted butter - 2 garlic cloves, minced - 1/4 cup chicken broth - 2/3 cup heavy cream - 1/4 cup parmesan, freshly grated, plus more for topping - Squeeze of lemon juice (about 1/4 lemon) - Fresh parsley, chopped - 1/2 cup reserved pasta water Steps: 1. Pat the thighs completely dry and season both sides with the salt, pepper, garlic powder, and paprika. 2. Put a pot of well-salted water on to boil for the pasta. 3. Heat a skillet over medium heat and place the chicken skin-side down. Cook 6-8 minutes without moving it, until the skin is golden and crispy. 4. Flip and cook another 5-7 minutes until cooked through (165°F / 74°C inside). Remove and set aside to rest. 5. Cook the penne 1 minute less than the package says. Save 1/2 cup of the pasta water before draining. 6. Lower the skillet heat. Add the butter to the same pan, then the garlic — cook just until fragrant, about 30 seconds. Don't let it brown. 7. Pour in the chicken broth and scrape up all the browned bits from the bottom. 8. Add the heavy cream and parmesan. Simmer 3-5 minutes until it thickens. 9. Toss the drained pasta into the sauce and cook together 1-2 minutes, adding splashes of the pasta water until the sauce is glossy and coats every piece. 10. Squeeze the lemon juice over the pasta, then place the chicken on top. 11. Finish with parsley and extra parmesan, and enjoy! #garlic #butter #chicken #pasta #easyrecipe

Start by seasoning your chicken breast with all purpose seasoning (or your choice of seasonings) add a drizzle of olive oil & mix well. 2. Using a stove with the pan on medium heat cook the chicken for approximately 8 - 10 minutes per side with a lid on top or until fully cooked through. Once cooked set aside. 3. Deglaze the pan with chicken broth then add diced garlic, let it cook & add fat free evaporated milk along with smoked paprika, chicken stock powder, oregano, light cream cheese, grated parmesan cheese & stir well until smooth & creamy.  4. Add chopped spinach to the sauce & let it simmer on low heat, while simmering shred the chicken apart using 2 forks then place the shredded chicken back into the pan. 5. Mix the creamy garlic sauce & chicken well to combine. 6. Place down a warm tortilla, add light cheddar cheese to one half of the tortilla along with a portion of the filling, another layer of cheddar & fold the tortilla over.  7. Toast the quesadilla on a pan on each side until golden brown & crispy, repeat for the other 9 quesadillas & enjoy! #quesadilla #chicken #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

videos.caption: Creamy Chipotle Chicken & Potatoes🍗🍟🧀 One of the most indulgent meal prep recipes, so creamy, rich in flavour and packed with protein. Using a sheet pan is a game changer for batch cooking🔥 Macros Per Serving (6 Total) 548 Calories | 51g Protein | 52g Carbs | 17g Fat Ingredients (Makes 6 Servings) Chipotle Chicken Marinade - 1200g Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat - 2.5 Tsp Salt - 3 Tsp Parsley - 3 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Cumin - 3 Tsp Onion Powder - 100g Chipotle Paste - 1 and 1/2 Limes, juiced - 30g or 6 Tsp Olive Oil Let this marinate overnight if possible, way more flavor! Crispy Seasoned Potatoes - 1300g Raw Yellow Potatoes, cubed - 2.5 Tsp Garlic Powder - 3 Tsp Italian Herbs - 3 Tsp Smoked Paprika - 2.5 Tsp Onion Powder - Avocado Cooking Spray, heavy pass Creamy Chipotle Sauce - 20g Light Butter - 150-200g Red Onion, finely chopped - 1.5 Tsp Salt - 2 Tsp Italian Herbs - 60-80g Chipotle Paste (depends how spicy you want it) - 400g Light Evaporated Milk - 110g Light Cream Cheese - Freshly Chopped Parsley, garnish 👨‍🍳 Cooking Instructions 1. Trim excess fat from chicken thighs. Add seasonings, chipotle paste, lime juice, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate. 2. Heat a large pan on low, add butter and chopped red onion. Cook for 5-7 mins until softened and lightly browned. Add seasonings and chipotle paste, mix, and cook for another 5 mins until caramelised. 3. Keep the heat low, add evaporated milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously until smooth, rich, and creamy. 4. Cube up potatoes, add seasoning and cooking spray, then mix well. Spread on a lined sheet pan and roast at 200C / 390F for 25 mins until golden and crispy. Season with salt, then fold into the sauce with fresh parsley until fully coated. 5. Spread marinated chicken on sheet pan, oven bake 25 mins 200C / 390F until golden and juicy. Cut into cubes, serve with creamy potatoes and ENJOY! . . . . #chipotle #chickenrecipes #mealprep #highprotein #healthyrecipes

MEATBALL SUB BITES! Homemade meatballs tossed in pizza sauce, then wrapped up in pizza dough with mozzarella and baked until golden brown, then brushed with butter, parm & parsley. And warm pizza sauce for dipping. It’s game day season and these are the perfect 2-bite app that we’re 100% sure everyone will love!!  Full recipe at: https://www.crowdedkitchen.com/meatball-sub-bites/ 1 lb 80/20 ground beef ½ cup Italian-seasoned breadcrumbs ½ cup whole milk 1 large egg ⅓ cup grated parmesan cheese 2 garlic cloves grated ¾ teaspoon kosher salt ½ teaspoon black pepper 8 ounces pizza dough 12 ounces pizza sauce divided ½ cup low-moisture mozzarella shredded 2 tablespoons melted butter for brushing Grated parmesan for topping Chopped parsley for topping Preheat your oven to 425˚F. To a small mixing bowl, add the breadcrumbs and milk together, stir, and let the mixture rest for five minutes. It should look like thick oatmeal, so add milk a tablespoon at a time if it looks dry. To a large mixing bowl, add the ground beef, panade, egg, parmesan, garlic, salt, and pepper. Mix gently by hand just until combined. Using a 3 tablespoon scoop, scoop into 14 meatballs and roll them into shape. Bake the meatballs 425°F for about 15 minutes. Slightly underbaked is fine; they'll be going back into the oven later. Toss the meatballs in about 4 ounces of the pizza sauce, setting the other half of the sauce aside for dipping later. They should be coated, not drenched. Cut the dough. Roll to ~12×10" and cut into squares. Grease a muffin tin. To make one of the meatball sub bites, add a square of pizza dough into one of the muffin slots, then place a pinch of shredded mozzarella on the bottom, a saucy meatball on top, and a pinch more mozzarella over it. Gather the corners over the top of the meatball, one at a time. Bake at 400°F for about 18-20 minutes, until deep golden and 160°F+ in the center. Brush with butter and parmesan before serving.

CHIPOTLE HONEY CHICKEN BOWLS CHICKEN 3 lb boneless skinless chicken thighs 1 can chipotle peppers in adobo* ¼ cup honey + more to drizzle ¼ cup olive oil + juice of 2 limes 1 Tbsp EACH garlic powder, onion powder + paprika 2 tsp EACH chili powder, cumin + oregano 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1 tsp black pepper Add everything to chicken, toss well + marinate. Spread on a sheet pan, drizzle with a little more honey + bake at 425°F for 20–25 min or until 165°F. Broil briefly at the end if you want more char. *Spicy: use the whole can, peppers + sauce. Mild: use the adobo sauce but leave out the peppers. CILANTRO-LIME RICE 3 cups long-grain rice + ¾–1 cup warm chicken broth + ½ cup cilantro + juice of 2 limes + 2 Tbsp olive oil + salt. Cook rice; while HOT, add cilantro, lime, oil + salt, then slowly add broth while fluffing until absorbed. CORN SALSA 3 cups corn (canned or frozen) + 1 diced jalapeño + ½ diced red onion + ½ bunch chopped cilantro + juice 1–2 limes + S&P. Mix. BLACK BEANS 2 cans black beans + 1 tsp cumin + salt + splash chicken broth. Warm together. PICO 4 tomatoes + ½ red onion + ½ bunch cilantro, all diced + juice 1–2 limes + salt. Mix. SHEET-PAN BEEF KEBABS 3 lb ground beef 1 large white onion + 1 red bell pepper 6 garlic cloves + 1 bunch parsley 2 Tbsp paprika + 1 Tbsp cumin 2 tsp EACH coriander + turmeric 1 Tbsp kosher salt + 1½ tsp black pepper ½ tsp cinnamon (optional) Food-process onion, pepper, garlic + parsley until finely chopped. Transfer to cheesecloth + squeeze out as much liquid as possible. Add to beef with all spices + hand mix. Press evenly onto a sheet pan. Use a bench scraper to make deep kebab-style rows as shown in the video. Bake at 425°F for ~15 min, carefully drain excess liquid/fat, then broil 3–5 min until browned. ROASTED PEPPERS + ONIONS 2 red + 2 yellow bell peppers + 2 red onions + 1 bunch scallions + 2 tsp EACH paprika + cumin + olive oil + S&P. Slice, toss + roast at 425°F for 20–25 min until tender + charred. QUICK TZATZIKI 2 cups Greek yogurt + 1 grated cucumber + 1 grated garlic clove + juice 1 lemon + ¼ cup dill + salt. Mix. Brush pita with olive oil + grill until lightly charred. Fill with tzatziki, beef kebab + roasted peppers and onions. MAPLE SWEET POTATOES 6 sweet potatoes, halved + a little olive oil + maple syrup. Rub all over, place CUT-SIDE DOWN + roast at 425°F until tender + deeply caramelized. BROCCOLI Broccoli florets + olive oil + garlic powder + S&P. Roast at 425°F until browned + crisp around the edges. Full recipes on Substack! #m#mealprepm#mealprepideass#sheetpandinnerk#kebabsc#chipotleC@ChipotleS@Sur La Table

Arsenio’s Chipotle Mac n Cheese Balls 🧀 Recipe👇🏽 Ingredients ½ lb (227 g) cavatappi pasta ¼ cup (57 g) butter ⅓ cup (40–45 g) all-purpose flour 1½ cups (360 ml) milk 1 tsp garlic powder 1 tsp paprika ½ tsp black pepper ¼ chicken bouillon cube, grated 1 tbsp chipotle pepper sauce 1 cup (100 g) shredded marble cheese 1 cup (100 g) shredded mozzarella 1 cup (100 g) extra shredded mozzarella for binding Salt to taste, if needed 2 eggs, beaten Panko breadcrumbs Oil for frying Instructions Cook the cavatappi in salted water until al dente, then drain well. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat. Add the garlic powder, paprika and black pepper, then stir in the flour. Cook for 1–2 minutes, stirring constantly. Gradually whisk in the milk until smooth. Keep stirring until the sauce thickens enough to coat the back of a spoon. Add the grated chicken bouillon and chipotle pepper sauce. Turn off the heat, add the marble cheese and mozzarella, and stir until melted. Taste and add salt if needed. Mix the cooked pasta into the cheese sauce until everything is coated. Add the extra 1 cup of shredded mozzarella and mix until combined. Scoop portions onto pieces of parchment paper. Wrap the parchment around each portion and twist the ends to form tight balls. Place on a tray and freeze for about 1 hour, or until firm. Dip each ball into the beaten eggs, then coat generously in panko breadcrumbs. Heat the oil to 350°F (175°C). Fry until golden and crispy, making sure the centres are heated through. Larger balls may need extra time, so test one first. Transfer to a wire rack to drain. Let them cool slightly, break one open and enjoy that cheesy centre. I hope it crunches! ❤️

Roasted Garlic Parmesan Chicken & Rice Bake🔥598 cals 62g protein 21g fat 38g carbs Ingredients: This makes 4 meals 2 lb boneless, skinless chicken breast, cubed 1 cup dry jasmine rice (185g) 2 cups low-sodium chicken broth 1 block (8oz) reduced-fat cream cheese ½ cup freshly grated parmesan cheese  1 whole garlic bulb 1 tsp olive oil Fresh parsley for garnish Seasoning blend: 2 tsp garlic powder 2 tsp Italian seasoning 2 tsp onion powder 2 tbsp smoked paprika 1 tsp salt ½ tsp black pepper Directions: 1. Preheat your oven to 400°. In a 9×13 baking dish, add your uncooked jasmine rice and chicken broth. Stir everything together and spread the rice evenly across the bottom. 2. In a large bowl, add your cubed chicken breast along with the entire seasoning blend. Toss thoroughly until every piece is evenly coated. 3. Place your seasoned chicken evenly on top of the rice mixture, keeping the tops of the chicken exposed. Slice the top off your whole garlic bulb to expose the cloves. Drizzle with olive oil and place it cut-side up alongside the chicken. Cover the dish tightly with aluminum foil. 4. Bake for 40–50 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165°F. If the rice is still firm, add a splash of hot broth, cover, and continue baking until tender. 5. Remove the foil and squeeze the softened garlic cloves into the rice. Add your reduced-fat cream cheese and grated parmesan cheese, then mix everything into the hot rice until melted and creamy 6. Return to the oven uncovered for another 5–8 minutes. For a golden finish, broil for the final 1–2 minutes, watching closely. Garnish with fresh parsley, divide evenly into 6 meals, and enjoy! High Protein Cheesy Chicken Alfredo Rolls🍗🧀🌯 65g Protein Meal Prep💪🏼 (Macros: Per Roll - 10 Total) 438 Calories 25gC | 13gF | 65gP Want more recipes like this? check out my high protein cook books with over 300 recipes 👨🏻‍🍳📚 Ingredients:  1.7KG Boneless & Skinless Chicken Breast (raw weight) 1 Tsp Smoked Paprika, 1 Tsp Onion Powder, 1 Tsp Garlic Powder, 1 Tsp Salt 1 Tsp Olive Oil 1 Large Diced Brown Onion 4 Diced Garlic Cloves 450g Low Fat Cottage Cheese 35g Grated Parmesan Cheese 100ml Low Fat Milk 2 Tsp Italian Herb Seasoning, 1/2 Tsp Black Pepper, 1/2 Tsp Salt 60g Light Cream Cheese 10 Warm Tortillas (Mission Carb Balance Tortillas) 40g Light Mozzarella (per roll - 10 total) Egg Wash or Light Cooking Oil Spray Topping: Grated Parmesan Cheese & Parsley Flakes Instructions: 1. Slice chicken into fillets. Season with paprika, onion powder, garlic powder & salt, drizzle with olive oil and mix. 2. Cook in a pan over medium-high heat for approximately 4 mins per side or until cooked through. Set aside and dice. 3. Cook onion in the chicken juices until softened. Add garlic and diced chicken, mix well, then turn off the heat. 4. Blend cottage cheese, parmesan, milk, Italian herbs, salt & cream cheese until smooth. 5. With the heat completely off, add the sauce, mozzarella & parsley to the pan and mix well. 6. Add 1/10th of the filling to each warm tortilla, add mozzarella, then roll tightly. 7. Place on a lined baking tray. Brush with egg wash or spray with oil, then top with parmesan & parsley flakes. 8. Bake at 190°C/375°F for 8 – 12 mins or until golden brown & crispy. #chicken #alfredo #highprotein #healthyrecipes #mealprep

9 Best Things to Do in Marrakesh 🕌✨ 1) Stay in a Riad 🛏️  feel the authentic Moroccan vibe, from the mosaic tiles to the whisper-quiet courtyards. Riads offer privacy, fewer crowds, and a home-away-from-home feel with traditional decor, often a peaceful rooftop terrace, and staff who treat you like family. Perfect for a truly Moroccan experience without the hotel hustle. 2) Best Coffee at Bacha Coffee ☕️✨ (Location: https://goo.gl/maps/6u3Xx9J9xqv1w9Qw7) Silky espresso, perfectly balanced blends, and a chic, relaxed atmosphere. Great latte art, friendly baristas, and a bright, stylish space to post your vibes. Pro tip: try their signature crush coffee and pastry pairing. 3) Explore the Souks 🧿🌀 Fun tip: haggle with a smile, never agree to the first price! Make it a playful game, sample spices, and test your bargaining skills. Lose yourself in ribbons of color, leather, pottery, and lamps. The thrill of the find is half the fun! 4) Visit Ben Youssef Madrasa 🕌 A jaw-dropping historic site with intricate tilework, carved wood, and serene courtyards. It’s a perfect spot for photos that scream old-world Marrakech charm. 5) Jardin Majorelle 🌿💙 iconic cobalt-blue paths, lush botanical displays, and a peaceful escape from the market buzz. A must-see for color lovers and plant enthusiasts, plus it’s connected to the Yves Saint Laurent legacy. 6) Ourika Valley Day Trip 🚙🌄 about 1 hour from central Marrakech (depending on traffic). What to expect: stunning valley scenery, Berber villages, waterfalls, and a cooler climate. A refreshing break from the medina with photo-worthy viewpoints. 7) Agafay Desert Experience 🐫🏜️ Highlights: camel ride under the open sky, squad  bike moments, and magical desert views. Luxe touch: stay at a desert camp with plush lounges, gourmet meals, and starlit dinners. Perfect for a memorable  outing. 8) Dinner at La Trattoria 🍝🇮🇹  warm, cozy ambiance with authentic Italian flavors in Marrakech. Great for a relaxed evening, fresh pastas, and a lively dining vibe after a day of exploration. 9) Jemaa el-Fnaa - The Heart of Marrakech 🎭💃 Do it for the vibes: bustling square, street performances, snake charmers, and a feast for the senses. Pro tip: bring some cash for photos with performers and for quick bites. Best times: late afternoon into evening when the energy peaks. #Marrakesh #Morocco #TravelTikTok #Riads #Souks

I’ve been seeing this chicken au poivre everywhere and wanted to try it.  Recipies below ⬇️ Bread Recipe: •4 cups bread flour (500g) •1½ cups + 1 tbsp warm water (375g) •2¼ tsp instant yeast (7g) @fleischmannsyeast  •1¾ tsp salt (10g) •2 tsp honey (10g) Mix water, honey, yeast, flour, and salt until just combined and sticky. Cover and rise 1½–2 hrs, doing 3–4 folds every 30 min. Divide into 3, shape, and proof 30–45 min. Score and bake at 475°F with steam for 10 min. Reduce to 450°F and bake 12–18 min until deeply golden. Cool 30 min before slicing. Chicken Au Poivre: •8 chicken thighs (bone-in + skin on)  seasonings: chicken soup blend, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, white pepper. •3 tbsp unsalted butter  •1 shallot  •3 garlic cloves  •1/4 cup light brandy  •1 cup chicken stock  •2 cups heavy whipping cream  •2 tbsp freshly ground black pepper  •1.5 tbsp fresh rosemary  •1 tbsp dijon mustard  •1 tbsp worcestershire sauce  •salt to taste  Sear chicken skin side down first for 25 minutes on low heat until golden, then flip and allow to cook another 10 minutes. Set chicken aside, add in butter, shallots and cook down for 1-2 minutes. Then add in garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Deglaze with brandy, and add in chicken stock, HWC, pepper, rosemary, Dijon, Worcestershire, and salt. Throw chicken + juices back in and allow to simmer on low for 25-30 mins.  Cheesy potato puree gratin: •8-10 medium Yukon gold potatoes  •1 stick of butter  •3 garlic cloves  •fresh rosemary + thyme  •2 cups milk  •white pepper  •grated nutmeg  •Parmesan cheese + mozzarella. Boil potatoes in heavily salted water until super tender. Melt butter in a sauce pan, cook garlic for 30 seconds, add in rosemary and thyme and cook for another 30 seconds, then add in milk, white pepper, and grated nutmeg, and salt to taste. Mix in riced potatoes with milk, and cheeses. Throw potatoes into a baking dish and broil until the top is golden.  Brussel sprouts seasoned with garlic butter herb seasoning + olive oil and baked at 450 for 20-25 mins .  Creme brûlée: •2 cups heavy cream  •1 vanilla bean (extract or paste work too) •6 egg yolks @Happy Egg  •1/2 cup sugar  •pinch of salt  Heat the heavy cream + vanilla bean until steaming. Whisk egg yolks, sugar, and salt. Slowly whisk in the hot cream to temper eggs then add in the rest. Pour into ramekins. Place in a water bath and bake at 325°F until set with a slight jiggle (40-60 mins varying by oven). Cool and refrigerate. Sprinkle sugar on top and torch until golden and crisp.  #chickenaupoivre #mashedpotatoes #cheesypotatopureegratin #homemadebread #cremebrulee

hands down the number 1 recipe I get tagged in with all of your beautiful remakes!! 🥰 it’s no surprise this one is so popular because it’s so so easy, made with simple ingredients, & tastes absolutely delicious!!  all of the recipe deets are below 💕  ingredients: * 2 tbsp olive or avocado oil * 1 lb boneless chicken thighs * 1 + 1/2 tsp salt * 1/2 tsp black pepper * 2 tsp smoked paprika * 2 tsp italian seasoning * 1/4 yellow onion, chopped * 3 garlic cloves, minced * 1 cup of white rice * 1 lemon, juiced * 1 cup chicken broth * 1/2 of 15oz can full-fat coconut milk * 2 cups chopped kale * up to 1 + 1/2 cups water, as needed * 1/3 cup fresh chopped parsley instructions:  1. preheat oven to 375 degrees and drizzle the olive oil on a large skillet over medium heat on the stovetop. 2. pat the chicken thighs dry with a paper towel, then season all over with the salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, and italian seasoning. transfer the chicken to the pan when the olive oil is heated. 3. cook the chicken to crisp each side, about 5-7 minutes on each side depending on thickness, then set aside on a plate. in the same pan, add the chopped onion and sauté for 5 minutes, then add the minced garlic. 4. when the onion and garlic are translucent, pour in the rice and let it toast for a few minutes, stirring frequently. add in the lemon juice, chicken broth, and coconut milk and mix to combine. 5. add in all of the chopped kale and let it wilt down. add up to 1 + 1/2 cups of water as needed to wilt down the kale and make sure all of the rice is covered in liquid. transfer to the oven and bake for 15-20 minutes, until the rice is fully cooked and the chicken has an internal temp of 165 degrees. 6. serve immediately or store the chicken and rice in airtight containers in the fridge for up to 4 days. #budgetshopping #groceriesonabudget #groceryshopping #groceryhaul #mealprep #mealprepping #mealprepideas #grocerylist #mealsonabudget #healthyonabudget #easyhealthyrecipes #glutenfreerecipes #dairyfreerecipes #onepotmeal

Add the ground chicken, cottage cheese, panko, Parmesan, egg, Italian seasoning, garlic powder, salt and pepper to a bowl. Mix gently until just combined. 2.	Roll into meatballs 3.	Heat a drizzle of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat. DUMP & BAKE SMOTHERED CHICKEN DINNER 🍗🤎 The kind of dinner that tastes like you spent all day in the kitchen, but really you just threw everything in a baking dish and let the oven do the work! Tender, juicy chicken smothered in homemade gravy with hardly any effort. Serve it over mashed potatoes or rice with your favorite sides and you’ve got yourself a good home-cooked meal! RECIPE BELOW ⬇️ Ingredients: 2 lbs boneless, skinless chicken thighs Olive oil Salt & pepper Garlic powder Onion powder Paprika Cajun seasoning (optional, for a little kick) 1 sprig fresh rosemary 2 tbsp butter 2 cups chicken broth Carrots or your favorite veggies 2 tbsp cornstarch + 2 tbsp water (use 3 tbsp of each for a thicker gravy) Directions: 1. Preheat oven to 350°F. Add chicken thighs and carrots to a baking dish. Drizzle with olive oil and season generously with salt, pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, and Cajun seasoning if using. Don’t be shy with the seasonings! This is where all your flavor comes from, so eyeball it and season heavily. 2. Add rosemary, butter, and chicken broth. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350°F for approximately 50 minutes. 3. Remove from oven and carefully pour just the broth into a separate bowl or measuring cup. 4. Mix 2 tbsp cornstarch with 2 tbsp cold water to make a slurry. If you prefer a thicker gravy, use 3 tbsp cornstarch and 3 tbsp water instead. Stir the slurry into the hot broth until well combined, then pour everything back over the chicken and veggies. 5. Return to the oven uncovered at 400°F for approximately 20 minutes, or until the gravy has thickened and the chicken is tender and fully cooked (165°F internally). Serve over creamy mashed potatoes or rice with green beans, a warm dinner roll, or whatever your heart desires! That’s the beauty of cooking. Make it how YOU like it! 🤎 Save this one for an easy, comforting weeknight dinner! #easymeal #easyrecipe #momlife #fallvibes #smotheredchicken

You will never be forgotten. 🕊️  Nutella Biscoff Cookie Pie 🍪🤎  Ingredients Cookie Dough * 200 g unsalted butter, melted * 160 g brown sugar * 70 g granulated sugar * 1 large egg * 1 egg yolk * 2 tsp vanilla extract * 290 g all-purpose flour * ½ tsp baking soda * ½ tsp baking powder * ½ tsp salt * 130 g semi-sweet or dark chocolate chips Filling * 250–300 g Nutella * 10–12 whole Biscoff cookies  Instructions 1. Preheat the oven to 175°C / 350°F and grease a 26 cm (10-inch) round baking pan. 2. Mix the melted butter with the brown sugar and granulated sugar until combined. 3. Add the egg, egg yolk and vanilla extract. Mix until smooth. 4. Add the flour, baking soda, baking powder and salt. Mix just until a cookie dough forms. 5. Fold in the chocolate chips. 6. Press about ⅔ of the cookie dough into the bottom of the pan and slightly up the sides. 7. Spread 250–300 g of Nutella evenly over the cookie dough, leaving about 1–2 cm around the edge. 8. Arrange 10–12 whole Biscoff cookies directly on top of the Nutella. 9. Flatten the remaining cookie dough between two sheets of parchment paper. Carefully place it over the Biscoff cookies and gently seal the edges. 10. Bake for 25–30 minutes, until the edges are golden brown but the center is still soft. 11. Let the cookie pie cool for at least 30 minutes before cutting.  #nutella #biscoff #chocolatechipcookie #Recipe #baking

Cream garlic parmesan chicken melt. For the creamy chicken filling : 2 tbsp butter  1/2 cup yellow onion, finely chopped  1 tbsp fresh garlic, minced  2 cup rotisserie chicken , shredded  Salt to taste 1 tsp garlic powder  1/2 tsp black pepper powder  1 tsp paprika powder  1 tsp red chili flakes 1/4 cup unsweetened heavy whipping cream  5 tbsp cream cheese  1/4 cup green onion, chopped  1/4 cup Parmesan cheese , freshly grated  1 tbsp parsley, chopped  To assemble  6 sliced bread of choice  1 1/2 cup mozzarella cheese, shredded  Butter for toasting  Method: Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat. Add the onion and cook for 4–5 minutes until soft and lightly golden. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds. Add the shredded rotisserie chicken, garlic powder, black pepper, paprika and chili flakes. Stir well and cook for 2 minutes so the seasonings coat the chicken. Lower the heat. Add the cream cheese and heavy cream, stirring until smooth and combined. Fold in the Parmesan. If the mixture is too thick, add heavy cream a teaspoon at a time. Stir in the green onion and parsley. Taste before adding salt. The mixture should be creamy and thick, not runny. Butter the outside of each bread slice. On the inside, layer mozzarella, a generous amount of creamy chicken, more mozzarella and the second slice of bread. Divide the filling and cheese evenly among three sandwiches. Cook over medium-low heat for about 3–4 minutes per side, until the bread is deeply golden and crisp and the cheese has melted. Cover the pan briefly if needed to help the center melt, then uncover to keep the crust crisp. Let each sandwich rest for about a minute before slicing and enjoy. #recipe #garlicparmesan #sandwich #cheese
